title: Maiolica – Apollo and Pan – Midas’s Judgement, 5 Euro
descriptionPlain: Description Inspired by the power of mythology and the beauty of ancient rivalry, this coin depicts the dramatic contest between Apollo – god of harmony – and wild Pan, judged by the legendary King Midas. It tells a story of art, ambition and the timeless pursuit of perfection, reflected in the unique porcelain insert, handcrafted by Polish Porcelain Factories “Ćmielów” and “Chodzież”.
